name: Discrete Bridge Rectifier — 70V — Diode
description: Through-hole discrete bridge rectifier cluster rated 70V, comprising 16 tier-A KiCad parts (e.g. GBU4B, GBU6B, GBU8B, KBPC1501T, KBPC1501W) spanning Vishay GBU/KBU, GeneSiC KBPC-W, and round D9.0mm/D9.8mm footprints.
selection_hints: All 16 parts are tier A with score 88, so differentiate by exact footprint match rather than tier.
Match the intended land pattern: Vishay GBU, Vishay KBU, GeneSiC KBPC_W, or round D9.0mm/D9.8mm.
Confirm through-hole mounting fits the board before selecting.
avoid_when: Design requires a surface-mount bridge rectifier instead of through-hole.
None of the listed footprints (GBU, KBU, KBPC_W, round D9.0mm/D9.8mm) match the target land pattern.
